evals.name: todo-sidebar-view
evals.prompt: Add a sidebar view that lists all notes tagged #todo with their due date from frontmatter, updating live. The plugin is in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A new ItemView in its own module, registered with registerView and opened via getRightLeaf/setViewState/revealLeaf; data from metadataCache (frontmatter + tags incl. frontmatter tags); live updates via registerEvent on metadataCache changed plus vault delete/rename, debounced; DOM via createEl; no view reference held on the plugin; due field taken from the existing settings; states how it would verify in the running app.

assertions.text: Registers the view with registerView and finds it with getLeavesOfType (no view instance stored on the plugin)
Reads tags and frontmatter via app.metadataCache (getFileCache / getAllTags), covering frontmatter tags as well as inline tags
Live updates come from this.registerEvent on metadataCache 'changed' and also handle delete/rename
Builds DOM with createEl/createDiv/empty and no innerHTML or inline style assignment
Uses the plugin's existing dueDateField setting rather than hardcoding 'due'
Does not detach leaves in onunload
States concrete runtime verification steps (build, reload, console check, DOM/screenshot) and says which could not run

evals.name: blank-settings-tab
evals.prompt: My plugin's settings tab renders blank — find out why. The plugin is in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the Settings are built into a detached element from the global createDiv() rather than containerEl, fixes it to containerEl (or containerEl.createDiv), and also flags/fixes the un-awaited this.loadSettings() in onload. Explains how it would confirm via runtime inspection (open settings tab by eval, count containerEl children, read console) and that it could not run that here.

assertions.text: Identifies the root cause: Settings are attached to a detached element from global createDiv() instead of containerEl
Fix attaches settings to containerEl (directly or via containerEl.createDiv)
Flags and fixes the un-awaited this.loadSettings() in onload
Describes runtime inspection to confirm (open the tab via eval or UI, inspect containerEl children / DOM, read console) or asks the user to report it
Does not claim to have verified in the running app when it could not

evals.name: callout-command-review-ready
evals.prompt: Add a command that wraps the current selection in a callout, and make it pass review. The plugin is in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: An addCommand with editorCheckCallback (or editorCallback) using editor.getSelection/replaceSelection; id/name free of plugin id/name and the word 'command'; no default hotkey; sentence-case name; prefixes every line of a multi-line selection with '> '; sets up or runs eslint-plugin-obsidianmd and checks the manifest description against submission rules.

assertions.text: Uses addCommand with editorCallback or editorCheckCallback and the Editor API (not vault.modify)
Every line of a multi-line selection is prefixed with '> ' under a [!type] header
Command id/name do not contain the plugin id/name or the word 'command', no default hotkeys, sentence case
Adds or runs eslint-plugin-obsidianmd (recommended config) as part of making it pass review
Checks the manifest/description against submission requirements
Logic for the transform is in a module separate from main.ts
